correctness.rationale: For root o and k>=1 labelled maximal leaves, literal upward-confluence applied to oRs forces every leaf to point to s, while back-up applied to bRo forces b to point to all leaves. Define U and V as universal leaf-target/source sets. If S nonempty, transitivity of o->s->u for u in U gives S=U; dually if B nonempty, V=B. A common element in U and V makes the leaf relation complete; intersecting S,B then forces every root edge and oRo, yielding exactly the complete exceptional relation. For disjoint S,B, transitivity excludes reverse block edges and leaves arbitrary transitive T on M, proving the exact B⊕T⊕S normal form. If c=1, confluence at oRo requires nonempty leaf rows and columns, respectively reducing to row/column fullness of T depending on absent B or S; if c=0 there is no extra condition. Counting partitions with |M|=j gives the two asserted binomial sums and the e.g.f. e^(2z)T(z). Independently implemented original quantified confluences and transitivity, and independently constructed all normal forms. Exact exhaustive comparison across all 16, 512 and 65536 binary relations for k=1,2,3 gave zero misses/extras; constructed k=4 gave 7182 valid frames split (5754,1428). Therefore all-k claim rests on algebraic necessity/sufficiency, not on k<=4 computation.
residual_risks: The k=4 check exhausts generated normal forms, NOT all 2^25 possible binary relations. The unrestricted theorem is proved symbolically by classification.
The modal R is transitive but not assumed reflexive; a stronger IS4 bi-preorder reflexivity assumption would change the census.
The theorem counts labelled root-and-leaf expansions only, not isomorphism classes nor the entire modal logic.

value.rationale: The rooted fork is the first natural branching departure from linear intuitionistic Kripke orders. Understanding all transitive accessibility relations satisfying both Fischer–Servi confluences is a motivating finite-frame structural question. The B⊕T⊕S decomposition classifies every k-fork for arbitrary k rather than tabulating tiny examples, and the distinct loop/no-loop formulas show precisely how root reflexivity changes the search space. These are directly reusable exact semantic model enumerators, not merely an arbitrary low-parameter slice or a routine substitution from the known unrestricted transitive-relation sequence.
residual_risks: No new completeness/decidability theorem for full IK4 is claimed.
The result does not simplify t_j beyond the already known transitive-relation census; value is in the fork structural bijection.

limitations: The 2026 highly relevant IK4 paper was abstract-only: arXiv full text retrieval failed, OA alternatives did not expose text, authorized institutional VPN disconnected; O remains expressly qualified.
